title: TTF panic spike fade (short 3d)
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] REVERSAL: TTF absolute return 20d z-score > 2.5 (panic spike) is faded over the next 3 days (-); trade short TTF=F 3d after the spike day [finance.TTF=F.abs_return -> finance.TTF=F.log_return]
message: Not supported: fading TTF volatility spikes loses (short rule: 49 trades, hit 47%, avg -0.59%/trade, Sharpe-like -0.91; war OOS avg -2.1%). Spikes show continuation, not reversal.

trade_idea.entry_rule: finance.TTF=F.abs_return rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> short TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.
